dict.string: OmniWM shows the macOS log out, restart and shut down confirmations from shell widgets.
OmniWM uses system audio recording to set the volume of individual apps and to show audio visualizers in shell widgets.
OmniWM shows your Bluetooth devices and their battery levels in shell widgets.
OmniWM shows your upcoming events in shell widgets.
OmniWM shows your reminders in shell widgets and completes reminders you choose.
OmniWM shows the name of your Wi-Fi network in shell widgets.
OmniWM shows the name of your Wi-Fi network in shell widgets.
A program running within OmniWM's Quake Terminal would like to use your microphone.
OmniWM uses screen capture for Overview thumbnails, window drag previews, and Hidden Bar icons.
